<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Arcantry 1.0.0</span><code>$audience-scope-discipline</code></p>

Keep product-facing or shared work faithful to its audience, scope, privacy boundary, and established artifact contract. Use when content, implementation, or a derived artifact could leak local context, drift in scope, or change an approved representation.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link audience-scope-discipline --scope user
arcantry skills link audience-scope-discipline --scope user --agent claude
arcantry skills link audience-scope-discipline --scope user --agent gemini
```

The default target is the Codex-compatible Agent Skills directory. Use the explicit agent profile for Claude Code or Gemini CLI.

## Examples

### Trim a technical product screen

**Prompt**

> Use $audience-scope-discipline to review this settings screen. Keep only information customers need to decide or act.

**Expected outcome**

An audience-based content decision that moves operational and diagnostic detail out of the default view.

### Guard a narrow implementation

**Prompt**

> Apply $audience-scope-discipline while implementing this request. Do not absorb adjacent cleanup or local setup into the product.

**Expected outcome**

The smallest coherent change, with material risks challenged once and unrelated improvements left separate.
